introduce: Sit upright. Inhale, lift your arms overhead with your palms facing inward, and stretch your chest out.\n\nExhale, slowly lower your arms back down. Repeat.
name: BACK ARCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you lift your arms and exhale when you lower them.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body.

introduce: Sit with your feet together. Exhale, spread your knees and feet apart as wide as possible, and raise your arms overhead. Inhale, return and repeat.
name: CHAIR JACKS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
To make it more of a challenge, you can hold light dumbbells in your hands.
Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
Exhale as you spread your legs, and inhale as you return.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
This exercise works all of your large muscle groups.

introduce: Sit with your feet together. Exhale, lift your right knee toward your chest as high as possible.\n\nInhale, slowly lower it back down. Switch to the other side and repeat.
name: CHAIR HIGH KNEES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
If you feel it\'s too easy, do it as fast as you can.
Lift your knees toward your chest as high as comfortably possible.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce:
Sit with your hands behind your ears and elbows pointing outward.

Exhale, raise your right knee and rotate your upper body to the right, bringing your left elbow to meet your right knee.

Inhale, return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat.
name: CHAIR ELBOW TO KNEE CRUNCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
Exhale as you lift your knee and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise works on your entire core.

introduce:
Place your hands behind your ears, with your elbows pointing outward.

Exhale, lean from your waist and contract your obliques, bending to one side as far as possible.

Inhale, return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat.
name: CHAIR SIDE BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Exhale as you bend to the side, and inhale as you return.
You can feel your obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce: Place your hands behind your ears, with your elbows pointing outward.\n\nInhale, hinge at your hips and lean your upper body forward. Exhale, return and repeat.
name: CHAIR FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Put your knees hip-width apart and keep them still.
Bring your upper body as close to your thighs as possible.
Inhale as you lean forward, and exhale as you come back.
You can feel the stretch in your glutes and back.

introduce: Bend your elbows and clench your fists at chin height.\n\nPunch forward alternately with both hands. Breathe regularly throughout.
name: CHAIR PUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Fully extend your arm with each punch.
Tighten your core.
Do it as fast as you can.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
